questions.question: How is the Dirichlet function defined?
options: $f(x) = \mathbb{1}_{\mathbb{Q}}(x)$
$f(x) = \sin x$
$f(x) = \mathrm{e}^x$
questions.explanation: The Dirichlet function is the indicator function of Q: f(x) = 1_Q(x), which is 1 on rationals and 0 on irrationals.

questions.question: Which statement correctly combines the two results?
options: The Dirichlet function is discontinuous everywhere and not Riemann integrable on any interval.
The Dirichlet function is continuous everywhere and Riemann integrable on every interval.
The Dirichlet function is differentiable everywhere and convex.
